attchmntText: Coastal Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Dr. Kambhampati Haribabu as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Coastal Corporation Limited held a Board Meeting on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited standalone and consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Dr. Kambhampati Hari Babu as an Additional Director and Whole Time Director, effective 14th November 2026. His appointment is for a period of five consecutive years, up to 13th November 2031. Dr. Hari Babu holds DIN 01179935. He is not debarred from holding office. He holds 75,28,700 fully paid-up equity shares in the company. The Board took note of quarterly and half-yearly compliances submitted to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Coastal Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Coastal Corporation Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited standalone and consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Dr. Kambhampati Hari Babu as an Additional Director and Whole Time Director, effective 14th November 2026. His appointment is for a period of five consecutive years, up to 13th November 2031. Dr. Hari Babu holds 75,28,700 fully paid-up equity shares in the company. The Board took note of quarterly and half-yearly compliances submitted to stock exchanges. The meeting commenced at 12.00 p.m. and concluded at 1.30 p.m.
